title: IT Infrastructure Service Desk Agent
description:
**Company Description**  

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. Eurofins believes it is a global leader in food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies.


In over just 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 62,000 staff across a network of more than 1000 independent companies in over 62 countries and operating more than 900 laboratories. Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products, as well as providing innovative clinical diagnostic testing services, as one of the leading global emerging players in specialised clinical diagnostics testing.


In 2022, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 6\.515 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

 **Job Description** **Job Title: Service Desk Engineer**  

**Work Location: Coimbatore, India**  

**Reporting to: Service Desk manager**  

**Mode of work: Permanent role**  

**Shift Timings: 12PM – 9PM or 3\.30PM – 12\.30AM**  

  

**Job Description**  

  

Are you passionate about IT and eager to grow your career in a dynamic, international environment? Join our Service Desk team in Coimbatore, India, where you’ll be the first point of contact for IT support across Europe, we´re looking for services desk.  

As a Service Desk Engineer, you’ll support over 20,000 users across 500 sites in Europe, ensuring smooth operations for our laboratories, offices, and VIP users. You’ll handle a wide range of IT issues, from Microsoft 365 to workplace hardware, and play a key role in delivering high\-quality service.

  

You will support our internal users across Europe from Coimbatore.  

  

**How can you help us?**  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Provide 1st line IT support for end users across Europe.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to: Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint) Windows 10/11Identity \& Access Management Printing and patching (desktop/server) Application triage and routing Register, classify, and follow up on tickets using internal processes.
* Escalate complex issues to 2nd line support when needed. Contribute to documentation, knowledge base articles, and service catalog improvements.
* Identify and document workarounds and recurring issues.

 **Qualifications:** Bachelor's degree or comparable education  

  

**Experience: 3 year\+** Basic experience in a Service Desk or IT support role is expected.

* Candidates must possess strong communication skills in English, French, and Spanish.
* Solid troubleshooting skills, especially with Windows and Microsoft 365\.
* A strong customer service mindset and initiative to resolve issues efficiently.
* A proactive, “can\-do” attitude and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.  

  

**Personal Skills:** Team Player, Smart worker, Quick learner, Willingness to work in off business hours with On\-call setup in needed.  

**Nice to have:** Experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, or networking.  

Familiarity with BMC Helix ticketing system. ITIL Foundation certification. Knowledge of Azure, SCCM, or Intune. Windows Patching management for end user devices

**What else should I know?**  

This is a fantastic opportunity to build your IT career in a highly collaborative, multilingual environment. You’ll be part of a team that values continuous improvement, learning, and knowledge sharing. If you're motivated by problem\-solving and thrive in a fast\-paced support role, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
### **Job Information**


* Job Type Permanant (Full Time)
* Work Experience 10 \- 14 years
* City Hyderabad
* Country India
### **Job Description**


**Senior Infrastructure Engineer**

 *Senior / Lead Level \| Full\-Time \| Hyderabad or Coimbatore, India (Hybrid/Onsite as applicable)*

**Role Summary**
----------------

  

We are looking for an experienced Senior Infrastructure Engineer with 10–14 years of experience to manage, automate, and secure enterprise infrastructure across hybrid cloud and on\-premises environments. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Linux/Windows administration, containerization and orchestration, identity \& access management, and infrastructure automation, along with a track record of supporting mission\-critical industrial and enterprise applications through their full operational lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Manage and support enterprise server environments and industrial/application infrastructure, ensuring high availability and performance.
* Design, build, and maintain Helm charts and containerized workloads; lead Docker/Podman to Kubernetes (K3S) migrations and orchestration.
* Integrate applications with centralized identity providers (Microsoft Entra ID, AD, LDAP) using Keycloak to deliver SSO and unified authentication.
* Develop and maintain automation and health\-check workflows using Ansible, Python, and Bash to reduce manual operational effort.
* Own CI/CD pipeline design, deployment automation, and GitLab administration, including troubleshooting runner and build failures.
* Drive infrastructure and application vulnerability remediation, OS/kernel patching, and security compliance activities.
* Lead disaster recovery (DR) drills, environment migrations, and release/change deployment activities.
* Provide L2/L3 incident, problem, and change management support following ITIL\-aligned processes.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional infrastructure, application, and vendor teams on server delivery, patching, and network segmentation.
* Support onboarding of new applications, POCs, and technology evaluations to enhance platform scalability and operational efficiency.
* Manage SSL certificate lifecycle and monitoring/alerting configuration across the environment.

**Required Skills \& Experience**
---------------------------------

* 10–14 years of experience in Linux, Windows, VMware, Cloud, and Automation technologies.
* Hands\-on expertise in Ansible, Python, Bash/PowerShell scripting, and Git\-based CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong experience with Kubernetes (K3S), Helm, Docker, and Podman in production environments.
* Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, and/or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* Experience with identity and access management platforms: LDAP, FreeIPA, Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID, and SSO integration.
* Solid understanding of ITIL\-based incident, problem, and change management practices.

**Technical Skills Matrix**
---------------------------

 **Skill Category**

 **Representative Tools / Technologies**

  

DevOps \& Automation

  

Ansible, Python, Bash, PowerShell, Git, CI/CD Pipelines, Helm, Kubernetes (K3S)

  

Cloud \& Virtualization

  

AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud (OCI), VMware, Docker, Podman

  

Operating Systems

  

Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, Solaris), Windows Server

  

Identity \& Security

  

AD, LDAP, FreeIPA, Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO Integration, Vulnerability Management

  

Infrastructure \& Monitoring

  

Server Provisioning, Monitoring \& Alerting, Disaster Recovery (DR), Performance Tuning

  

IT Service Management

  

Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management (ITIL)

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) and/or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
* Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE) or equivalent Microsoft infrastructure certification.
* Prior experience supporting industrial/IoT or retail\-technology assets (e.g., self\-driving vehicles, smart checkout systems) is a plus.
* Experience with orchestration/flow tools beyond Ansible (e.g., custom automation or low\-code flow platforms) is a plus.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree in computer applications, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Reduced manual operational effort through automation of repetitive infrastructure tasks.
* Stable, secure, and audit\-ready infrastructure with proactive vulnerability remediation.
* Reliable CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments supporting rapid, low\-risk releases.
* Strong cross\-team collaboration enabling smooth onboarding of new applications and platforms.

title: ETO Mechanical Engineer
description:
**India, Coimbatore**
---------------------


**Digital Technology \& Research, Engineering \& Design, Manufacturing**
------------------------------------------------------------------------

 The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for assisting in providing innovative and cost effective solutions requiring the development or sustaining of new or improved techniques, procedures or products. The Mechanical Engineer also assist in planning, conducting and evaluating approaches to meeting the project objectives in a timely fashion.


* Assist in identifying and organizing requirements. Apply relevant usability procedures and principles.
* Analyze, design, develop, maintain products and assist in their commercialization.
* Build prototypes, products and systems suitable for testing. Set up and run lab simulations. Design and implement tests, document results and develop customer presentations. Provide timely corrective actions on defects.
* Produce analyses and mathematical models and draw design conclusions based on those.
* Conduct or participate in technical reviews of requirements, specifications, designs, code and other artifacts. Contribute to design standards and support design re\-use.
* Create and maintain product documentation. Provide support to field and customers through InTouch. Provide user training as required.
* Assign, direct and review work of technicians and provide guidance to engineers. With seniority, mentor junior engineers.
* Continually evaluate engineering approaches and risks.
* Author technical reports, papers, articles, patents and presentations. Share expertise via Eureka and special interest groups. Expand informal network throughout the organization.
* Keep abreast of novel technical concepts and markets. Adopt new practices readily to develop innovative and low\-cost products.
* Maintain familiarity with company technology, organization and business.
* Comply with Sarbanes\-Oxley requirements as defined in the risk control matrix.

BE Mechanical
